info.title: TubeOnAI Developer API
info.description:
Developer-friendly REST API for summarizing and transcribing content at scale.

## Supported Sources

| Source | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| **YouTube** | `youtube` | YouTube videos (public and unlisted) |
| **Article** | `article` | Web articles, blog posts, news, Twitter/X posts |
| **Podcast** | `podcast` | Podcast episodes (RSS feeds, Spotify, Apple) |
| **Document** | `document` | PDF, DOCX, TXT files, Google Drive, Google Sheets |
| **Audio** | `audio` | MP3, WAV, M4A audio files, SoundCloud tracks |
| **Rumble** | `rumble` | Rumble videos |
| **Video** | `video` | TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Facebook, Dailymotion, Twitch, direct video URLs |
| **PowerPoint** | `powerpoint` | PPTX, PPT presentation files |

## Quick Start

1. Generate an API key in [Settings → Developer](https://web.tubeonai.com/settings/developer)
2. Include it in the `Authorization` header: `Bearer toai_sk_your_key`
3. Submit content URLs (or upload files) to create summaries
4. Poll `/progress` or receive a webhook when processing completes

## Rate Limits

- **60 requests/minute** per API key (configurable per key)
- Concurrent processing limits based on your plan

Every response includes an `X-Request-ID` header that mirrors the `request_id` field in the JSON body — use it when contacting support.

## Response envelope

All successful JSON responses follow this shape (`UsageBlock` and `Links` are first-class schemas you can reference from generated SDKs):

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "...",          // optional
  "data": { ... },            // endpoint-specific
  "request_id": "req_...",
  "usage": {                   // UsageBlock — when a workflow is dispatched or credits are charged
    "credits_reserved": 10,    // when processing is queued
    "credits_used": 0,         // when result comes from cache
    "remaining_credits": 99996
  },
  "_links": { ... }            // Links — HATEOAS hyperlinks on progress and repurpose endpoints
}
```

Errors follow (`error_code` is enumerated by the `ErrorCode` schema):

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Human-readable reason",
  "error_code": "validation_error",
  "errors": { "field": ["detail"] },   // only on 422
  "request_id": "req_..."                // present when authenticated
}
```

## Content status values

The API normalizes internal statuses to these values in every response:

| API status | Meaning |
|------------|---------|
| `pending` | Queued, not yet picked up |
| `processing` | Actively being worked on |
| `completed` | Ready — summary/transcription available |
| `failed` | Processing ended with an error (see `error` and `error_code`) |

## Webhook events

If you supply `webhook_url` when creating a summary, TubeOnAI POSTs the following events to that URL while the job runs. Each delivery is a [`WebhookEventPayload`](#tag/Webhooks). Endpoints must respond with `2xx` within 10 seconds; the worker retries up to 3 times with `10s/30s/60s` backoff on failure. Private/internal IP ranges are blocked.

| Event | When it fires | Notes |
|-------|---------------|-------|
| `summary.processing` | Status transitions to `processing` | Includes `started_at` |
| `summary.progress`   | Every change to `processing_progress` while still `processing` | Includes `progress` (0–100) |
| `summary.completed`  | Status transitions to `completed` (summary ready) | Includes `summary`, `key_points`, `word_count`, and `language` when translated |
| `summary.failed`     | Status transitions to `failed` | Includes `error`, `error_text`, `failed_at` |
| `webhook.test`       | Delivered only by `POST /webhooks/test` | Used to validate your endpoint before going live |

Transcription and repurpose webhooks are not currently emitted — poll the `/progress` or `/repurpose/{id}` endpoints for those workflows.

## Tone case

The `options.tone` enum on `POST /summaries` is documented in Title Case (`Neutral`, `Professional`, `Casual`, `Humor`, `Academic`). The backend accepts these values case-insensitively (e.g. `professional` and `PROFESSIONAL` are normalized to `Professional` server-side), so existing integrations sending lowercase keep working. The `tone` enum on `POST /repurpose` is a separate, lowercase-only enum (`professional`, `casual`, `academic`, `persuasive`, `informative`).

post.description:
Create a new summary request from a URL or uploaded file.

**URL content** — send `application/json` with at least a `url`. Content type is auto-detected from the URL if `type` is omitted; it is correct for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Facebook, Spotify, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud, Google Drive, and many other public platforms.

**File upload** — send `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part. Max file size **50 MB**. Supported MIME types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, TXT, MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM.

**Idempotency** — backend deduplicates by `(user_id, url)`, which is what produces the `cached: true` (200) and `duplicate_request: true` (409) responses. Sending an optional `Idempotency-Key` header is recommended for clients that retry on network failure; the value is recorded for traceability today and gives us room to tighten dedup semantics later without breaking integrators.

**Webhooks** — if you set `webhook_url` in the request body, the events `summary.processing`, `summary.progress`, `summary.completed`, and `summary.failed` are POSTed to that URL as the job runs. The callback payload shape is documented under the `callbacks` section below and on the [Webhook events](#section/Webhook-events) reference table in the intro.

**Response codes**
- `202` Accepted — new workflow queued
- `200` OK — matched an existing record (`cached: true`)
- `409` Conflict — a concurrent request won the duplicate race (`duplicate_request: true`)
- `402` Payment Required — wallet balance is zero or below `required_credits`
- `422` Validation — body failed validation

2XX.description: Webhook accepted. TubeOnAI considers any 2xx response a successful delivery.

get.description: List all summaries available to the authenticated user (both API- and app-created).

delete.description: Detach the summary from the authenticated user's library. Uploaded source files are also removed from storage.

get.description: Real-time progress for a summary workflow. Poll every 5–10 seconds while `is_processing` is true, or use `webhook_url` for push notifications.

post.description:
Create a transcription-only request. Cheaper than a full summary when the transcript alone is sufficient.

Supports `application/json` (URL) and `multipart/form-data` (file). Like `POST /summaries`, this endpoint deduplicates by `(user_id, url)` and accepts an optional `Idempotency-Key` header — see the [Summaries idempotency note](#operation/createSummary).

get.description: Returns videos (transcription-only or summary+transcription) created via the current API key that have a transcription available.
Only works on resources created as transcription-only. Calling it on a summary returns `400 invalid_request`.

400.description: Resource is not a transcription-only request

422.description: Validation error or prompt limit reached

post.description: Repurpose an existing summary. Provide EITHER `prompt_id` (saved prompt) OR `prompt` (inline text). When `save_prompt=true` the inline prompt is persisted and `prompt_title` becomes required.

422.description: Validation error or prompt limit reached

get.description:
`{id}` accepts three forms:

1. **Summary UUID** — returns all repurposes for that summary (`RepurposesBySummaryResponse`).
2. **Repurpose ID** (integer) — returns one repurpose (`RepurposeSingleResponse`).
3. **Prompt ID** + `?summary_id=` query — same as (2), resolved via prompt+summary join (works even after the prompt is deleted).

parameters.name: summary_id
parameters.description: Required only when `id` is a prompt ID

post.description:
Sends a test payload to a webhook URL. The server blocks private/internal IP ranges and non-URL values.

Example payload delivered to your endpoint:
```json
{
  "event":"webhook.test",
  "data":{"message":"...","request_id":"req_...","user_id":123},
  "timestamp":"2026-01-07T12:34:56+00:00"
}
```

BearerAuth.description: Send your TubeOnAI API key (`toai_sk_...`) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Generate keys at [Settings → Developer](https://web.tubeonai.com/settings/developer).

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Use together with `offset` to paginate; the response includes a `pagination` envelope (`PaginationMeta`).

LimitPrompt.name: limit
LimitPrompt.description: Page size for prompt/repurpose listings. Use together with `offset`; default is higher than other list endpoints.

Offset.name: offset
Offset.description: Number of records to skip. Pair with `limit` to fetch the next page (`offset + limit`).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-supplied key (UUID or any opaque string up to 128 chars) that identifies a single create attempt. The backend already deduplicates summary requests by `(user_id, url)` — which is what produces the `cached: true` / `409 duplicate_request` responses — and this header is recorded for traceability so a future change to dedup behavior won't break integrators relying on idempotent retries. Recommended for any client that retries network failures.

url.description: URL of the content to summarize.

type.description: Optional — auto-detected from the URL when omitted.

tone.description: Summary tone. Sent as Title Case; the backend accepts these values case-insensitively (e.g. `professional` is normalized to `Professional`).

custom_prompt.description: Inline custom prompt. If provided and the user has room below their prompt limit, a saved prompt is auto-created; otherwise the prompt is used inline.

prompt_id.description: Saved prompt to apply. Must belong to the authenticated user. Mutually exclusive with `options.custom_prompt`.

webhook_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to receive a completion webhook. Private/internal IPs are rejected.

CreateSummaryFileRequest.description: Multipart file upload. Max 50 MB. Supported: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, TXT, MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM.

type.description: Auto-detected from MIME type when omitted.
Auto-detected when omitted. Transcription is only supported for these sources.

CreateTranscriptionFileRequest.description: Audio/video file upload for transcription. Max 50 MB.

UsageBlock.description: Credit accounting block attached to responses when a workflow is dispatched or a cached result is served. Either `credits_reserved` (job queued) or `credits_used` (cached result / charge settled) is present, plus `remaining_credits`.

credits_reserved.description: Credits held from the wallet for this job. Released on success/refund with the actual usage recorded. Present when a new workflow was dispatched.

credits_used.description: Credits spent on this call (0 when result is cached).

Links.description: HATEOAS-style hyperlinks attached to responses that have follow-up resources. Each value is an absolute URL on the API host.

result.description: Where to fetch the final processed output.

summary.description: The originating summary, when the response is a sub-resource (e.g. a repurpose).

check_status.description: Endpoint to poll for status — returned on accepted repurpose jobs.

message.example: Summary request created successfully. Processing will begin shortly.

data.description: URL-created jobs include title/duration/thumbnail (pre-fetched for YouTube). File-uploaded jobs include `filename` instead of `title`.

is_retry.description: Present when the accepted job is a retry of a previously failed video.

has_transcript.description: Present when an existing transcription is reused, skipping re-transcription.

key_points.description: Array of key bullet points, may be null.

variant.description: Present only when cache hit matched a specific model/detail_level/tone/prompt combo.

SummaryDuplicateResponse.description: Returned as 409 when concurrent requests race to create the same content.

credits_used.description: Present when the video's metadata recorded credit usage.

error_code.description: Present when `status=failed`. Subset of the global `ErrorCode` enum applicable to a finalized failed video.

transcription.description: Format depends on `options.output_format`. Plain string for `text`/`srt`/`vtt`, object for `json`.

transcription_only.description: True when the record was created via `/transcriptions` (not a side-effect of a summary).

ProgressHistoryEntry.description: One event in the filtered-current-run history.

CreateRepurposeRequest.description: Provide `prompt_id` OR `prompt` (one of the two is required). Use `save_prompt:true` (with `prompt_title`) to persist an inline prompt.

RepurposeCachedResponse.description: Returned either as still-processing (no content yet) or completed (with `cached:true` and `content`).

RepurposesBySummaryResponse.description: Returned when the path parameter resolves to a summary (video) UUID.

total_requests.description: Lifetime usage count of the authenticated API key (or sum across all keys under user auth).

api_key.description: Included when authenticated via an API key.

api_keys_summary.description: Included when authenticated with user session (not API key).

CreditHistoryResponse.description: Row shape differs by `type`: `usage`/`refund` items come from `CreditUsageLog`; `credit`/`debit` items come from `CreditLedger`. Amounts are always signed (positive=credit, negative=debit).

credits.description: Signed: positive for credit, negative for debit.

url.description: Must be a public URL (private/internal ranges are rejected).

WebhookEventName.description: Event name carried in the `event` field of every webhook delivery. See the [Webhook events](#section/Webhook-events) reference table for the full catalog.

WebhookEventPayload.description: Envelope POSTed to a customer-supplied `webhook_url` when a `summary.*` event fires, and to a test URL by `POST /webhooks/test` for `webhook.test`. The `data` block is event-specific (see `oneOf` below). Validate the `event` field first, then branch on it.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the webhook job was dispatched (TubeOnAI side, not your endpoint).

WebhookDataSummaryProgress.description: `data` block for `summary.progress`. Fired on each `processing_progress` change while status is `processing`.

WebhookDataSummaryCompleted.description: `data` block for `summary.completed`. Includes the rendered summary and any translation that was applied for the requesting user's preferred language.

key_points.description: Array of bullet points; may be null.

language.description: Present only when the summary was translated into the user's preferred language.

message.example: This is a test webhook from TubeOnAI Developer API

response_code.description: Only when endpoint responded with non-2xx.

response_body.description: Truncated to 500 chars. Only when endpoint responded with non-2xx.

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination envelope returned on every list endpoint (`/summaries`, `/transcriptions`, `/prompts`, `/repurpose`, `/credits/history`). The window over the result set is described by `limit`/`offset`; use `has_more` to decide whether to request the next page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

limit.description: Echoed from the query param — may appear as a string when passed as a URL parameter.

has_more.description: True when `offset + limit < total`. Increment `offset` by `limit` to fetch the next page.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error identifier emitted by the Developer API. Use this (not `message`) for branching logic. Authentication failures (`401`) and rate-limit failures (`429`) are returned without an `error_code` field — see the `UnauthorizedResponse` and `RateLimitedResponse` schemas.

required_credits.description: Present when the check was quantitative.

UnauthorizedResponse.description: Auth failures do NOT include `error_code` or `request_id`.

BadRequest.description: Bad request (invalid file type, unsupported content, etc.)
